# A standard_single_item_catalog

Clean baseline product images that should be easy to cut out.

## A01 white background short sleeve t-shirt seed

- Expected: top x1
- Difficulty: baseline, white_background, single_item
- Acceptance: One top item, clean outline, no background residue.

```text
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: closet cutout test image. Primary request: a single plain short sleeve t-shirt laid flat on a pure white studio background. Subject: cotton t-shirt, front view, sleeves naturally spread, no model, no hanger. Composition/framing: centered product catalog shot with generous padding, full garment visible. Lighting/mood: soft even studio lighting, minimal shadow. Constraints: no logo, no text, no watermark, no other objects.
```

## A02 striped long sleeve shirt

- Expected: top x1
- Difficulty: baseline, pattern, sleeve_edges
- Acceptance: One top item, cuffs and collar preserved.

```text
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: closet cutout test image. Primary request: a blue and white striped long sleeve button-up shirt laid flat on a pure white studio background. Subject: front-facing shirt with collar, buttons, cuffs, and long sleeves fully visible. Composition/framing: centered catalog product photo, generous padding. Lighting/mood: soft even lighting. Constraints: no model, no hanger, no logo, no text, no watermark.
```

## A03 light wash wide-leg jeans
